title: Data Broker Removal Request Letter Template (Free Download)
metaDescription: Free template to request data removal from brokers. Professional letter format with step-by-step instructions to protect your privacy.
description: Professional letter template to request removal of your personal information from data brokers and people search sites. Includes legal references and step-by-step guidance to maximize your chances of successful data removal.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Formal Request
sections.content:
Subject: Formal Request for Data Removal - [Your Full Name]

Dear Privacy Officer,

I am writing to formally request the complete removal of all personal information associated with my identity from your database and any affiliated systems. This request is made under applicable privacy laws and your company's stated privacy policy.

sections.heading: Personal Information to Remove
sections.content:
Please remove all records containing the following information:

• Full Name: [Your Full Name]
• Current Address: [Your Current Address]
• Previous Addresses: [List Previous Addresses]
• Phone Numbers: [Your Phone Numbers]
• Email Addresses: [Your Email Addresses]
• Date of Birth: [Your DOB if found]
• Any associated family member information
• Any derived or inferred data profiles

sections.heading: Legal Basis and References
sections.content:
This request is made pursuant to:

• The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) - Right to Delete
• State privacy laws in [Your State]
• Your company's published privacy policy
• The principle of data minimization and consent

I have not provided explicit consent for the collection, processing, or sale of my personal information to your organization.

sections.heading: Identity Verification and Documentation
sections.content:
To verify my identity for this request, I am including:

• Copy of government-issued photo ID (with sensitive information redacted)
• Proof of current address
• This signed letter

I understand you may require additional verification, but please limit any requests to information necessary to confirm my identity for this deletion request only.

sections.heading: Specific Removal Requirements
sections.content:
I request that you:

1. Remove all personal information from your active databases
2. Remove information from any backup systems within a reasonable timeframe
3. Notify any third parties who have received my data to delete it
4. Confirm in writing that deletion has been completed
5. Implement measures to prevent re-collection of my information
6. Provide details on your data retention and deletion policies

sections.heading: Response Timeline and Contact Information
sections.content:
Please confirm receipt of this request within 5 business days and complete the data removal within 30 days as required by applicable privacy laws. Send confirmation to:

[Your Email Address] or [Your Mailing Address]

If you cannot fulfill this request, please provide a detailed written explanation of why removal is not possible and cite the specific legal basis for retaining my information.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]
